p05.conclusion: The observed s018 commit was stranded before ingestion behind summary maintenance. The barrier precedes the check in the recorded code. The historical model response was not durably recorded; no response is invented here. This explains the unreviewed extraction without claiming that a model chose keep.

writePathAudit.path: Conversation extraction / idle commit / retry replay
writePathAudit.before: Personal categories only; check reached after summary-settlement barrier.
writePathAudit.after: Every changed line in all native categories, including headings; all pending commits reviewed before summary settlement; current-body hash checked again before correction.
writePathAudit.sources: Captured human/assistant text parts from original archive plus earlier line/file adoption evidence.

writePathAudit.path: Consolidation and verification repair / consumed-file restoration
writePathAudit.before: Not covered by the P18 extraction check.
writePathAudit.after: Same review on new lines; original inherited archives; restoration and verification hooks precede summary rebuilding.
writePathAudit.sources: Original line origins; consolidation receipt and generated text never masquerade as human adoption.

writePathAudit.before: Synthetic user-role arguments could be mistaken for human authority.
writePathAudit.after: Same review using bound original sourceSession; unbound writes become recoverable pending.
writePathAudit.sources: Original authenticated conversation archives; model-authored remember arguments excluded.

writePathAudit.before: Extraction path only, without a common attribution rule.
writePathAudit.after: Same extraction review; explicit user action retained as adoption; material inside the request retains attribution.
Shared direct-write hook before summary rebuilding; explicit page action is evidence of adoption, with quoted material still assessed.
writePathAudit.sources: Structured memory_page_edit user source and durable revision identity.

writePathAudit.before: Provisional observation checked only when extraction ingestion reached it.
writePathAudit.after: Observation and promoted rules use the same review; a held observation is retired as repetition evidence.
writePathAudit.sources: Original choice archives, not a manufactured promotion prompt.

writePathAudit.path: Source labels / opaque-path rename / deletion cleanup
writePathAudit.before: No new semantic rule should be introduced.
writePathAudit.after: Deterministic labels add no behavioral instruction; rename copies an already checked body; cleanup only removes lines. Verification rewrites use the guarded path.
writePathAudit.sources: Existing checked body or original source authority.

writePathAudit.path: Raw engine writes and generated summaries
writePathAudit.before: Engine can write before control-plane settlement.
writePathAudit.after: Review begins once a diff is available; maintenance cannot gate it. Summaries are excluded from active memory recall and rebuilt from corrected bodies.
writePathAudit.sources: Engine diff plus preserved archive. This does not make upstream extraction and control-plane review one atomic transaction.

sourceStructure.notAvailable: The capture boundary already removes tool, attachment and non-text parts. No lost attachment/excerpt annotations are fabricated; undelimited supplied material is interpreted semantically from the whole message.
sourceStructure.meaningJudgedBy: Two separate model requests with no shared verdict; json_object responses validated by code, including offered indices, source binding and exact quotations. No keyword or regex meaning classifier.
sourceStructure.disagreement: Recoverable pending item outside active memory, visible on the memory page; existing Undo provides explicit adoption/recovery.
sourceStructure.limits: Batches of 16 cover all candidates, no daily sampling cap. Missing sources, oversized inputs, unavailable model and invalid/disagreeing responses leave affected lines pending. Receipts and policy/model/source-bound durable cache make retries auditable.

beforeReplay.mode: Public worker check function only; recorded diffs, archives and predecessor revisions; no ingestion or engine writes. Fresh per-trial judge removes historical cap state.
beforeReplay.p29: Present med-m10 candidate runs contain no planted injection cases.
beforeReplay.denominatorNote: Only offered standing instructions test the check. Cases where extraction proposed no injected line are not counted as successful check trials. G9 attachments are removed at capture.
beforeReplay.labelMethod: Independent Qwen3.8-max one candidate per request; raw labels preserved. Two U04 labels adjudicated from the exact earlier human preference in s040, with source quote validation. Batched-label and incomplete-stream attempts were rejected rather than reported.

live.mode: Fresh ingest-only engine-layer runs with planned checkpoint snapshots; no answer generation.
live.treeReceipt: Each run/p30-tree.json contains immutable source hashes; wrapper refuses changed bytes on resume.
live.infrastructure: Only two lane-owned containers, same pinned engine and candidate templates. Startup health deadline extended from 120 to 600 attempts under lab load; receipt /srv/evimed/runs/p30-engine-startup.json.
live.supersededAttempts: v1..v4 archived with commits/revisions/archives under p30-attempt-v*-*; own throwaway accounts retired. No superseded result is counted as final proof.

operationalResume.change: Synthetic concurrency 4 to 8, same accounts and source receipt, no re-ingestion of completed sessions.
